EDFI 300.description: Social, political, and historical aspects of diverse educational institutions in American culture with an emphasis on families, schools, and communities. Sophomore standing.
EDFI 300.subject: EDFI
EDFI 300.title: Schools in Communities

EDFI 321.description: Extensive treatment of the social, political, economic, and philosophical influences that have shaped public education. Analysis of the financial, organizational, and legal aspects of education. Library assignments provide a working knowledge of professional standard references and journals. Junior or higher standing.
EDFI 321.subject: EDFI
EDFI 321.title: Dynamics of American Public Education

EDFI 350.description: Basic concepts, issues, and practices of antiracist education. Topics include individual and institutional racism, overt and covert racism, curriculum, textbooks, power relationships, teacher-student relationships, and privacy.
EDFI 350.subject: EDFI
EDFI 350.title: Antiracist Education

EDFI 357.description: Analysis of educational institutions, organizations, processes, and their effects in contemporary society.
EDFI 357.subject: EDFI
EDFI 357.title: Sociology of Education

EDFI 361.description: Understanding of schooling in a global society. An introduction to comparative and international education and its major theories practices and research methodologies with an examination of educational issues, levels and system in a variety of cultural contexts and countries.
EDFI 361.subject: EDFI
EDFI 361.title: Comparative and International Education

EDFI 399.description: Contract approved by instructor, advisor, and department chair is required for undergraduate students.
EDFI 399.subject: EDFI
EDFI 399.title: Independent Study

EDFI 592.description: A survey of the history, philosophy, administration, and legal bases of American education.
EDFI 592.subject: EDFI
EDFI 592.title: Historical Foundations of American Educational Thought

EDFI 643.description: Development of educational institutions in Southern society with special attention given to South Carolina.
EDFI 643.subject: EDFI
EDFI 643.title: Southern Educational History

EDFI 722.description: A comparison of the impact of postwar forces on the educational systems of selected European nations. Analysis of current trends, movements, and problems in all levels of education. Examination of the educational purposes, systems, techniques, and facilities with implications for the future development of industrialized societies.
EDFI 722.subject: EDFI
EDFI 722.title: Contemporary Education in Europe

EDFI 730.description: Foundations of qualitative research including historical, philosophical, and theoretical perspectives. Examination of different qualitative approaches and associated methodological issues.
EDFI 730.subject: EDFI
EDFI 730.title: Qualitative Epistemologies, Paradigms, Theories

EDFI 731.description: Qualitative research methods including naturalistic inquiry, participant observation, interviewing, focus groups, and document analysis.
EDFI 731.subject: EDFI
EDFI 731.title: Qualitative Inquiry

EDFI 740.description: Qualitative research methods including naturalistic inquiry, participant observation, interviewing, focus groups, and document analysis.
EDFI 740.subject: EDFI
EDFI 740.title: Qualitative Inquiry

EDFI 741.description: Introduction to international education and the comparative method in the study of educational systems around the world. Provides students with an overview of comparative and international education theory, practice, and research methodology.
EDFI 741.subject: EDFI
EDFI 741.title: International and Comparative Education

EDFI 743.description: The history of education in the United States from the colonial period through the contemporary moment. Placing the history of education in a larger American economic, social, political, and cultural context, students consider the development, purposes, effects, and evolution of public and private schools in the United States at the elementary, middle and secondary levels during this critical period in United States history and education.
EDFI 743.subject: EDFI
EDFI 743.title: The History of Education in the United States

EDFI 744.description: The functional considerations governing educational theories and practices.
EDFI 744.subject: EDFI
EDFI 744.title: Philosophy and Education

EDFI 746.description: The study of historic and contemporary social theory and the application of social theory to current issues in education.
EDFI 746.subject: EDFI
EDFI 746.title: Social Theories in Education

EDFI 747.description: An introduction to tenets and methodology in Critical Race Theory. The study of race and racism as the primary lens of analysis in educational, social, and political issues.
EDFI 747.subject: EDFI
EDFI 747.title: Critical Race Theory and Education

EDFI 749.description: Basic concepts of the relation of the school to the social order: an analysis of the essential features of the changing social context within which American educational policy and practice now operate. The educational implications of recent social change in American life and of the emergence of a new world order.
EDFI 749.subject: EDFI
EDFI 749.title: The School in Modern Society

EDFI 832.description: Examination of biography as a form of educational research and scholarship.
EDFI 832.subject: EDFI
EDFI 832.title: Educational Biography

EDFI 833.description: Exploration of the various forms of narrative inquiry as a distinct genre of qualitative research.
EDFI 833.subject: EDFI
EDFI 833.title: Narrative Inquiry

EDFI 834.description: Theoretical, methodological, and pedagogical orientations to participatory action research.
EDFI 834.subject: EDFI
EDFI 834.title: Participatory Action Research

EDFI 836.description: Historical, methodological, and theoretical orientations to ethnographic research.
EDFI 836.subject: EDFI
EDFI 836.title: Ethnography and Education

EDFI 837.description: The study and practice of qualitative case study methods. Topics include explanatory, descriptive, and exploratory approaches, single case, multi-case, and multi-site design strategies.
EDFI 837.subject: EDFI
EDFI 837.title: Qualitative Case Study

EDFI 843.description: The impact of education on the social order in the United States continued–1877 to the present. Research assignments will involve analysis and interpretation of primary source materials of 19th- and 20th-century thought and practice in South Carolina.
EDFI 843.subject: EDFI
EDFI 843.title: The School and the Social Order: the United States II

EDFI 845.description: Individual topics selected by student application and instructor acceptance. May be repeated for up to 9 hours as topics vary.
EDFI 845.subject: EDFI
EDFI 845.title: Seminar of Advanced Students in Foundations of Education

EDFI 847.description: Critical comparison of present-day schools of thought in the nature, objectives, and functions of American education.
EDFI 847.subject: EDFI
EDFI 847.title: Modern Philosophies of Education

EDFI 848.description: A critical and comparative exploration of different theoretical and discursive frameworks, policies and practices that have constituted and shaped the broad and interdisciplinary field of gender and education.
EDFI 848.subject: EDFI
EDFI 848.title: Gender and Education

EDFI 857.description: An advanced study of how Critical Race Theory is applied by researchers to investigate issues of racial justice. The study of race and racism is the primary lens of analysis in understanding disparities in educational, political, social and economic outcomes.
EDFI 857.subject: EDFI
EDFI 857.title: Advanced Critical Race Theory and Education

EDFI 868.description: An overview of the role of student activists who engaged in deliberate protest to demonstrate their dissatisfaction with the American social order and an examination of the rationale behind student rebellion and the role of high schools and colleges in facilitating student activism.
EDFI 868.subject: EDFI
EDFI 868.title: History of Student Activism

EDFI 879.description: Internship dedicated to equity and justice in educational contexts.
EDFI 879.subject: EDFI
EDFI 879.title: Equity and Justice Internship
